## Goal
One router for web chat and Telegram: decides onboarding vs copilot from verified identity, keeps sessions continuous across channels.

- `services/channels/src/router.ts`
- `services/channels/src/router-deps.ts`

## Tests first (write them, see them fail, then implement)
- startOnboarding conditional put (two first messages -> one onboarding) and referral recorded.
- AgentCore invoke with runtimeSessionId = sessionId (min length padding); 25 s timeout sends a natural holding line, then the real reply.
- webchat replies publish to /owners/<sub>/chat; Telegram replies via telegram-send.
